title: Yaxel Lendeborg has 31 points, 12 rebounds as Warriors blow out Nuggets on road
author: Hana
summary: ESPN reported Yaxel Lendeborg's 31-point, 12-rebound breakout in just his fourth NBA game as the Warriors dominated Denver on the road — a reminder that sometimes the best stories arrive without warning.

content.value:
## There's a small story hiding in today's headlines.

ESPN (Anthony Slater) reported: **"Yaxel Lendeborg has 31 points, 12 rebounds as Warriors blow out Nuggets on road"**

Box scores don't capture all of it. This is the part that usually gets left out — the fact that this was only Yaxel Lendeborg's fourth NBA game. Fourth. Most rookies are still trying to figure out the rotation, still getting a feel for the speed of it all, still wondering when to shoot and when to pass. And here's Lendeborg on Monday night in Denver, putting up 31 points, 12 rebounds, and six assists in a blowout road win like he's been doing this for years. There's something quietly remarkable about a player who steps into the chaos of the league and just *produces* like that, no adjustment period, no feeling-out process. The Warriors went into altitude and left with an easy W, and their rookie was the reason why.
